response.original_title: Disney Cruise Line Complaint Guide: How to Submit a Customer Service Complaint
response.overview: To file a complaint with Disney Cruise Line (DCL) 1-(866) 254-7549, the best contact method depends on whether you are currently on a ship or have already returned from your vacation. If You Are Currently Onboard Always report any issues immediately 1-(866) 254-7549 while on the ship so the crew can try to fix them right away. By Email: Send a detailed message to dcl.guest.communications@disneycruise.com.Online Form: You can also use the official Disney Cruise Line Email Contact Page 1-(866) 254-7549 and select "My Recent Cruise" as the subject line. General Support Phone Numbers If you prefer to speak to a representative over the phone to track an existing issue or talk through a pre-cruise booking error, you can use the following numbers: United States & Canada: Call (866) 254-7549.United Kingdom: Call 0866 254 7549.Other International Regions: Locate your regional contact line directly on the Disney Cruise Line Phone Directory 1-(866) 254-7549.
